```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
box::use(../../R/vit)

data <- vit$get_vitamin_data(outcome = NULL, simple_analysis = TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(study, intervention, assigned.N, bias) %>%
  filter(bias == "low")

sample.size <- rep(NA_character_, 9)
vits <- c("D","B","zinc","magnesium","selenium","C","iron","placebo",
          "antidepressant")
names(sample.size) <- vits

for(v in vits) {
  sample.size[vits == v] <- data %>% 
    filter(str_detect(intervention, v)) %>% 
    pull(assigned.N) %>% 
    sum() %>% prettyNum(big.mark = ",")
}
  
```

## {data-background-color="#0f2238" .hero-slide .ambient-dark}

<div class="title-wrap">
<div class="eyebrow">20-minute clinical talk</div>
<h1 class="title-headline">Do vitamins actually help<br>depression and anxiety?</h1>
<div class="title-sub">What the best evidence shows</div>
<div class="title-author">Eric Dunipace<span class="title-affil">UCLA Psychiatry Residency</span></div>
<div class="title-meta">Based on a systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials</div>

::: notes
Welcome — today I'm going to walk you through a systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis we completed this year on micronutrient supplementation for depression and anxiety. I want to give you a clinically useful take on what the evidence actually supports — and just as importantly, what it doesn't.
:::

::: notes
The clinical motivation is real. I'd guess most of you have fielded questions like these in clinic. The problem is the literature is genuinely hard to interpret — fish oil, turmeric, vitamins all get grouped under "nutritional psychiatry." Our goal was to cut through that by looking at individual micronutrients, in only the highest-quality trials.
:::

::: notes
We screened over 5,000 records. 101 RCTs made it in, but the primary analysis was restricted to the 50 studies rated low risk of bias. The PRISMA here shows the full flow. Notice we were quite selective — we weren't counting everything with "vitamin" in the title.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  if (window.__includedStudiesAutoAnimated) return;
  window.__includedStudiesAutoAnimated = true;

  const container = document.getElementById("included-studies-look");
  if (!container) return;
  const slide = container.closest("section");
  const rows = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(".study-row"));
  let timers = [];

  const clearTimers = () => {
    while (timers.length) window.clearTimeout(timers.pop());
  };

  const resetRows = () => {
    clearTimers();
    rows.forEach((row) => row.classList.remove("visible"));
  };

  const playRows = () => {
    resetRows();
    rows.forEach((row, index) => {
      const delay = 180 + index * 620;
      timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => {
        row.classList.add("visible");
      }, delay));
    });
  };

  const sync = () => {
    if (slide && slide.classList.contains("present")) {
      playRows();
    } else {
      resetRows();
    }
  };

  const bindReveal = () => {
    if (typeof Reveal === "undefined" || typeof Reveal.on !== "function") return false;
    if (container.dataset.autoBound === "true") return true;
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", sync);
    Reveal.on("ready", sync);
    container.dataset.autoBound = "true";
    sync();
    return true;
  };

  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (bindReveal()) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (bindReveal()) window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, 120);
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }
})();
</script>
```

::: notes
Vitamin D dominates this literature — 32 of 50 low-RoB studies. Notice anxiety was studied far less than depression. Flag the 78% — most studies didn't confirm whether participants were actually deficient before supplementing them. That becomes really important for the subgroup analyses.
:::

## How to compare across studies?

<!-- hidden fragments: each press of “next” advances one stage -->
<div id="smd-frag-1" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1" style="height:0; margin:0; padding:0;"></div>
<div id="smd-frag-2" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2" style="height:0; margin:0; padding:0;"></div>
<div id="smd-frag-3" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3" style="height:0; margin:0; padding:0;"></div>
<div id="smd-frag-4" class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4" style="height:0; margin:0; padding:0;"></div>

```{=html}
<div id="smd-stage" style="margin-top: 6px;"></div>
<script>
(() => {
  if (window.__smdStandaloneInitialized) return;
  window.__smdStandaloneInitialized = true;

  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const stageEl = document.getElementById("smd-stage");
  if (!stageEl) return;

  const width = 980;
  const height = 544;
  const margin = { top: 72, right: 40, bottom: 92, left: 74 };
  const muControl = 58;
  const muTreat = 50;
  const sdControl = 9;
  const sdTreat = 11;
  const pooledSD = Math.sqrt((sdControl ** 2 + sdTreat ** 2) / 2);
  const rawDiff = muTreat - muControl;
  const smd = rawDiff / pooledSD;
  const xMin = 15;
  const xMax = 95;
  let arrowAnimatedForStage = -1;
  let hasAnimatedMeanArrow = false;
  const controlColor = "#5B8FD1";
  const treatmentColor = "#E15759";
  const summaryYControl = 218;
  const summaryYTreat = 286;

  const normalPdf = (x, mu, sd) =>
    (1 / (sd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))) * Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mu) / sd) ** 2);

  const xs = [];
  for (let value = xMin; value <= xMax + 0.001; value += 0.25) xs.push(value);
  const controlCurve = xs.map((x) => ({ x, y: normalPdf(x, muControl, sdControl) }));
  const treatCurve = xs.map((x) => ({ x, y: normalPdf(x, muTreat, sdTreat) }));
  const yMax = Math.max(...controlCurve.map(d => d.y), ...treatCurve.map(d => d.y)) * 1.18;

  const scaleX = (x) => margin.left + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * (width - margin.left - margin.right);
  const scaleY = (y) => height - margin.bottom - (y / yMax) * (height - margin.top - margin.bottom);

  const make = (tag, attrs = {}, text) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([key, value]) => el.setAttribute(key, value));
    if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
    return el;
  };

  const pathFrom = (points) => {
    return points.map((point, index) => {
      const cmd = index === 0 ? "M" : "L";
      return `${cmd} ${scaleX(point.x).toFixed(2)} ${scaleY(point.y).toFixed(2)}`;
    }).join(" ");
  };

  const addText = (svg, x, y, text, attrs = {}) => {
    svg.appendChild(make("text", { x, y, ...attrs }, text));
  };

  const addSummaryEstimate = (svg, y, mean, sd, label, color, stage, group = svg) => {
    const xLo = scaleX(mean - sd);
    const xMean = scaleX(mean);
    const xHi = scaleX(mean + sd);
    const labelY = stage >= 3 ? y + 26 : stage >= 2 ? y + 26 : y + 22;
    group.appendChild(make("line", { x1: xLo, x2: xHi, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: color, "stroke-width": "4" }));
    group.appendChild(make("line", { x1: xLo, x2: xLo, y1: y - 10, y2: y + 10, stroke: color, "stroke-width": "3" }));
    group.appendChild(make("line", { x1: xHi, x2: xHi, y1: y - 10, y2: y + 10, stroke: color, "stroke-width": "3" }));
    group.appendChild(make("circle", { cx: xMean, cy: y, r: 7, fill: color }));
    addText(group, margin.left + 22, y - 16, label, {
      "font-size": "17",
      "font-weight": "700",
      fill: color
    });
    addText(group, xMean, labelY, `mean = ${mean}, SD = ${sd}`, {
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      "font-size": "16",
      "font-weight": "500",
      fill: "#35516d"
    });
  };

  const draw = (stage) => {
    stageEl.innerHTML = "";
    const svg = make("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      style: "display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;"
    });

    const defs = make("defs");
    const marker = make("marker", {
      id: "arrow-smd-inline",
      viewBox: "0 -5 10 10",
      refX: "9",
      refY: "0",
      markerWidth: "7",
      markerHeight: "7",
      orient: "auto"
    });
    marker.appendChild(make("path", { d: "M0,-5L10,0L0,5", fill: "#222" }));
    defs.appendChild(marker);
    svg.appendChild(defs);

    const plotLeft = margin.left;
    const plotRight = width - margin.right;
    const plotTop = margin.top;
    const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;

    const axisGroup = make("g");
    const curveGroup = make("g");
    const summaryGroup = make("g");

    if (stage <= 1) {
      [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].forEach((tick) => {
        const y = plotBottom - tick * (plotBottom - plotTop);
        axisGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
          x1: plotLeft,
          x2: plotRight,
          y1: y,
          y2: y,
          stroke: "#d7e3f3",
          "stroke-width": "1"
        }));
      });
      axisGroup.appendChild(make("line", { x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: plotBottom, y2: plotBottom, stroke: "#7e96b4", "stroke-width": "1.5" }));
      axisGroup.appendChild(make("line", { x1: plotLeft, x2: plotLeft, y1: plotTop, y2: plotBottom, stroke: "#7e96b4", "stroke-width": "1.5" }));
    } else {
      svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: plotBottom, y2: plotBottom, stroke: "#7e96b4", "stroke-width": "1.5" }));
    }

    [20, 40, 60, 80].forEach((tick) => {
      const x = scaleX(tick);
      svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: x, x2: x, y1: plotBottom, y2: plotBottom + 7, stroke: "#7e96b4", "stroke-width": "1.5" }));
      addText(svg, x, plotBottom + 20, String(tick), {
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "16",
        fill: "#4a4a4a"
      });
    });

    if (stage <= 1) {
      [0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03].forEach((tick) => {
        const y = scaleY(tick);
        axisGroup.appendChild(make("line", { x1: plotLeft - 7, x2: plotLeft, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "#7e96b4", "stroke-width": "1.5" }));
        addText(axisGroup, plotLeft - 12, y + 5, tick.toFixed(2), {
          "text-anchor": "end",
          "font-size": "16",
          fill: "#4a4a4a"
        });
      });
    }

    addText(svg, width / 2, height - 26, "Outcome scale", {
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      "font-size": "20",
      fill: "#222"
    });

    if (stage <= 1) {
      const yAxisTitle = make("text", {
        transform: `translate(24 ${height / 2}) rotate(-90)`,
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "20",
        fill: "#222"
      }, "Density");
      axisGroup.appendChild(yAxisTitle);
    }

    let headline = "Start with the raw distributions";
    let subhead = "Two groups can differ on the original outcome scale.";
    if (stage === 1) {
      headline = "Collapse each distribution into mean ± SD";
      subhead = "This is the summary information used to compute a standardized effect.";
    } else if (stage === 2) {
      headline = "Then compute the raw mean difference";
      subhead = "Treatment mean minus control mean gives the unstandardized gap.";
    } else if (stage === 3) {
      headline = "Now scale that gap by the pooled SD";
      subhead = "Using a shared SD makes the effect comparable across different measures.";
    } else if (stage === 4) {
      headline = "Finally: the standardized mean difference";
      subhead = "SMD expresses the mean difference in units of standard deviations.";
    }

    addText(svg, plotLeft, 28, headline, { "font-size": "28", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#000" });
    addText(svg, plotLeft, 56, subhead, { "font-size": "16", "font-weight": "500", fill: "#4a4a4a" });

    if (stage <= 1) {
      curveGroup.appendChild(make("path", {
        d: pathFrom(controlCurve),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: controlColor,
        "stroke-width": "4"
      }));

      curveGroup.appendChild(make("path", {
        d: pathFrom(treatCurve),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: treatmentColor,
        "stroke-width": "4"
      }));

      addText(curveGroup, scaleX(89), plotTop + 14, "Control distribution", {
        "text-anchor": "end",
        "font-size": "17",
        "font-weight": "500",
        fill: controlColor,
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        "stroke-width": "4",
        "paint-order": "stroke"
      });
      addText(curveGroup, scaleX(88), plotTop + 62, "Treatment distribution", {
        "text-anchor": "end",
        "font-size": "17",
        "font-weight": "500",
        fill: treatmentColor,
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        "stroke-width": "4",
        "paint-order": "stroke"
      });
    }

    if (stage >= 1) {
      addSummaryEstimate(svg, summaryYControl, muControl, sdControl, "Control", controlColor, stage, summaryGroup);
      addSummaryEstimate(svg, summaryYTreat, muTreat, sdTreat, "Treatment", treatmentColor, stage, summaryGroup);
      summaryGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: margin.left,
        x2: width - margin.right,
        y1: 258,
        y2: 258,
        stroke: "#d7e3f3",
        "stroke-width": "1.5",
        "stroke-dasharray": "5,5"
      }));
      addText(summaryGroup, margin.left + 10, 156, "Summary estimates", {
        "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "16",
        "font-weight": "600",
        fill: "#5f7897"
      });
    }

    if (stage <= 1) svg.appendChild(axisGroup);
    if (stage <= 1) svg.appendChild(curveGroup);
    if (stage >= 1) svg.appendChild(summaryGroup);

    if (stage === 1) {
      axisGroup.style.opacity = "1";
      curveGroup.style.opacity = "1";
      summaryGroup.style.opacity = "0";
      axisGroup.style.transition = "opacity 1200ms ease";
      curveGroup.style.transition = "opacity 1200ms ease";
      summaryGroup.style.transition = "opacity 900ms ease 180ms";
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        axisGroup.style.opacity = "0";
        curveGroup.style.opacity = "0";
        summaryGroup.style.opacity = "1";
      });
    }

    if (stage >= 2) {
      const arrowY = 180;
      const xStart = scaleX(muControl - 0.7);
      const xEnd = scaleX(muTreat + 0.7);
      const arrow = make("path", {
        d: `M ${xStart} ${arrowY} L ${xEnd} ${arrowY}`,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "#222",
        "stroke-width": "3",
        "stroke-linecap": "round",
        "marker-end": "url(#arrow-smd-inline)"
      });
      svg.appendChild(arrow);

      const rawLabel = make("text", {
        x: (xStart + xEnd) / 2,
        y: arrowY - 18,
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "15",
        "font-weight": "600",
        fill: "#222"
      }, `Mean difference = ${rawDiff.toFixed(1)}`);
      svg.appendChild(rawLabel);

      if (!hasAnimatedMeanArrow && arrowAnimatedForStage !== stage) {
        const totalLength = arrow.getTotalLength();
        arrow.style.strokeDasharray = `${totalLength} ${totalLength}`;
        arrow.style.strokeDashoffset = totalLength;
        arrow.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset 700ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)";
        rawLabel.style.opacity = "0";
        rawLabel.style.transition = "opacity 300ms ease";
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          arrow.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          setTimeout(() => { rawLabel.style.opacity = "1"; }, 520);
        });
        arrowAnimatedForStage = stage;
        hasAnimatedMeanArrow = true;
      } else {
        arrow.style.strokeDasharray = "none";
        arrow.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
        rawLabel.style.opacity = "1";
      }
    }

    if (stage >= 3) {
      const pooledGroup = make("g");
      const controlLo = scaleX(muControl - sdControl);
      const controlHi = scaleX(muControl + sdControl);
      const treatLo = scaleX(muTreat - sdTreat);
      const treatHi = scaleX(muTreat + sdTreat);
      const pooledCenter = (scaleX(muControl) + scaleX(muTreat)) / 2;
      const pooledHalf = (scaleX(muControl + pooledSD) - scaleX(muControl)) / 2;
      const pooledLo = pooledCenter - pooledHalf;
      const pooledHi = pooledCenter + pooledHalf;
      const controlSdY = 338;
      const treatSdY = 370;
      const pooledY = 404;
      const controlSdLo = scaleX(muControl);
      const controlSdHi = scaleX(muControl + sdControl);
      const treatSdLo = scaleX(muTreat - sdTreat);
      const treatSdHi = scaleX(muTreat);

      pooledGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: controlSdLo, x2: controlSdHi, y1: controlSdY, y2: controlSdY,
        stroke: controlColor, "stroke-width": "3", opacity: "0.45"
      }));
      pooledGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: treatSdLo, x2: treatSdHi, y1: treatSdY, y2: treatSdY,
        stroke: treatmentColor, "stroke-width": "3", opacity: "0.45"
      }));
      addText(pooledGroup, controlSdLo + 8, controlSdY - 12, "Control SD", {
        "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "14",
        "font-weight": "600",
        fill: controlColor
      });
      addText(pooledGroup, treatSdHi - 8, treatSdY - 12, "Treatment SD", {
        "text-anchor": "end",
        "font-size": "14",
        "font-weight": "600",
        fill: treatmentColor
      });

      pooledGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: (controlSdLo + controlSdHi) / 2, x2: pooledCenter - 22,
        y1: controlSdY + 4, y2: pooledY - 18,
        stroke: "#9aa8b7", "stroke-width": "2.5", "stroke-dasharray": "5,5"
      }));
      pooledGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: (treatSdLo + treatSdHi) / 2, x2: pooledCenter + 22,
        y1: treatSdY, y2: pooledY - 18,
        stroke: "#9aa8b7", "stroke-width": "2.5", "stroke-dasharray": "5,5"
      }));

      pooledGroup.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: pooledLo, x2: pooledHi, y1: pooledY, y2: pooledY,
        stroke: "#444", "stroke-width": "3.5", "stroke-linecap": "round", opacity: "0.95"
      }));
      addText(pooledGroup, pooledCenter, pooledY + 28, `Pooled SD = ${pooledSD.toFixed(1)}`, {
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "16",
        "font-weight": "600",
        fill: "#222"
      });
      addText(pooledGroup, pooledHi + 14, pooledY - 8, "shared average spread", {
        "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "12",
        "font-weight": "500",
        fill: "#5f7897"
      });
      addText(pooledGroup, pooledHi + 14, pooledY + 6, "across both groups", {
        "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "12",
        "font-weight": "500",
        fill: "#5f7897"
      });
      svg.appendChild(pooledGroup);
    }

    if (stage >= 4) {
      const boxW = 274;
      const boxH = 100;
      const boxX = width - boxW - 42;
      const boxY = 96;
      svg.appendChild(make("rect", {
        x: boxX, y: boxY, width: boxW, height: boxH, rx: "14", ry: "14",
        fill: "#f7f7f7", stroke: "#cfcfcf"
      }));
      addText(svg, boxX + boxW / 2, boxY + 28, "Standardized mean difference", {
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "14",
        "font-weight": "600",
        fill: "#222"
      });
      addText(svg, boxX + boxW / 2, boxY + 54, `SMD = ${rawDiff.toFixed(1)} / ${pooledSD.toFixed(1)}`, {
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "15",
        "font-weight": "500",
        fill: "#222"
      });
      addText(svg, boxX + boxW / 2, boxY + 82, `${Math.abs(smd).toFixed(2)} SD lower`, {
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "21",
        "font-weight": "700",
        fill: "#111"
      });
    }

    addText(svg, width - 30, height - 26, `Step ${stage + 1} of 5`, {
      "text-anchor": "end",
      "font-size": "16",
      fill: "#777"
    });

    stageEl.appendChild(svg);
  };

  const resolveStage = () => {
    const slide = stageEl.closest("section");
    if (!slide || !slide.classList.contains("present")) return;
    let stage = 0;
    if (slide.querySelector("#smd-frag-1.visible")) stage = 1;
    if (slide.querySelector("#smd-frag-2.visible")) stage = 2;
    if (slide.querySelector("#smd-frag-3.visible")) stage = 3;
    if (slide.querySelector("#smd-frag-4.visible")) stage = 4;
    draw(stage);
  };

  const onFragment = (event) => {
    const slide = stageEl.closest("section");
    if (slide && slide.contains(event.fragment)) resolveStage();
  };

  const onSlideChanged = () => {
    resolveStage();
  };

  const bindReveal = () => {
    if (typeof Reveal === "undefined" || typeof Reveal.on !== "function") return false;
    if (stageEl.dataset.revealBound === "true") return true;
    Reveal.on("fragmentshown", onFragment);
    Reveal.on("fragmenthidden", onFragment);
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", onSlideChanged);
    stageEl.dataset.revealBound = "true";
    resolveStage();
    return true;
  };

  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (bindReveal()) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (bindReveal()) window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, 120);
  };

  draw(0);
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }
})();
</script>
```

## What's a network meta-analysis?

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="2" style="padding: 16px 18px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfdff 0%, #f3f7fc 100%); border: 1px solid #d8e4f0; border-radius: 14px; min-height: 438px;"}
<div style="font-size:0.72em; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6a809a; margin-bottom:6px;">Bayesian random-effects model</div>
<div style="font-size:1.02em; font-weight:750; color:#003B5C; margin-bottom:10px;">The model estimates the average effect and the disagreement between studies</div>

- <strong><span class="mu-accent">μ</span></strong> = the pooled average treatment effect
- <strong><span class="tau-accent">τ</span></strong> = how much true effects vary across studies

```{=html}
<div id="mini-mu-build" style="margin-top: 14px;"></div>
<script>
(() => {
  if (window.__miniMuBuildInitialized) return;
  window.__miniMuBuildInitialized = true;

  const root = document.getElementById("mini-mu-build");
  if (!root) return;
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const studies = [
    { yi: -0.42, lo: -0.77, hi: -0.07 },
    { yi: -0.15, lo: -0.39, hi: 0.09 },
    { yi: -0.63, lo: -1.06, hi: -0.20 },
    { yi: -0.05, lo: -0.25, hi: 0.15 },
    { yi: -0.36, lo: -0.67, hi: -0.05 },
    { yi:  0.08, lo: -0.19, hi: 0.35 },
    { yi: -0.27, lo: -0.49, hi: -0.05 },
    { yi: -0.54, lo: -0.93, hi: -0.15 }
  ];
  const history = [
    { k: 1, muMean: -0.3637, muLo: -0.9945, muHi:  0.3452 },
    { k: 2, muMean: -0.2497, muLo: -0.7397, muHi:  0.2301 },
    { k: 3, muMean: -0.3433, muLo: -0.7644, muHi:  0.0575 },
    { k: 4, muMean: -0.2532, muLo: -0.6164, muHi:  0.0575 },
    { k: 5, muMean: -0.2676, muLo: -0.5507, muHi: -0.0247 },
    { k: 6, muMean: -0.2110, muLo: -0.4767, muHi:  0.0164 },
    { k: 7, muMean: -0.2167, muLo: -0.4274, muHi: -0.0329 },
    { k: 8, muMean: -0.2480, muLo: -0.4521, muHi: -0.0740 }
  ];

  const width = 420;
  const height = 236;
  const margin = { top: 24, right: 22, bottom: 34, left: 42 };
  const plotLeft = margin.left;
  const plotRight = width - margin.right;
  const plotTop = margin.top + 28;
  const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;
  const xMin = -1.1;
  const xMax = 0.4;
  const rowGap = 15;
  const posteriorY = plotTop + studies.length * rowGap + 16;
  const x = (v) => plotLeft + ((v - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * (plotRight - plotLeft);
  const yForRow = (i) => plotTop + i * rowGap;

  const make = (tag, attrs = {}, text) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([k, v]) => el.setAttribute(k, v));
    if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
    return el;
  };

  const fmt = (v) => `${v < 0 ? "−" : ""}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}`;

  const draw = (step, animate = false) => {
    root.innerHTML = "";
    const svg = make("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      style: "display:block;width:100%;height:auto;"
    });

    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: x(0), x2: x(0), y1: plotTop - 10, y2: posteriorY + 10,
      stroke: "#b6c2d0", "stroke-width": "2", "stroke-dasharray": "4,5"
    }));

    const frame = make("rect", {
      x: 16, y: 16, width: width - 32, height: height - 44,
      rx: "14", fill: "#ffffff", stroke: "#d8e4f0", "stroke-width": "1.5"
    });
    svg.appendChild(frame);

    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: 32, y: 34, "font-size": "13", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#5f7897"
    }, "Study estimates + posterior μ"));

    const visibleRows = Math.max(0, Math.min(studies.length, step));
    for (let i = 0; i < visibleRows; i++) {
      const row = studies[i];
      const y = yForRow(i);
      const animateRow = animate && i === visibleRows - 1;
      const g = make("g", { opacity: "1" });
      const line = make("line", {
        x1: x(row.lo), x2: x(row.hi), y1: y, y2: y,
        stroke: "#7C8798", "stroke-width": "2.5", "stroke-linecap": "round"
      });
      const leftCap = make("line", {
        x1: x(row.lo), x2: x(row.lo), y1: y - 4, y2: y + 4,
        stroke: "#7C8798", "stroke-width": "2"
      });
      const rightCap = make("line", {
        x1: x(row.hi), x2: x(row.hi), y1: y - 4, y2: y + 4,
        stroke: "#7C8798", "stroke-width": "2"
      });
      const point = make("rect", {
        x: x(row.yi) - 4.5, y: y - 4.5, width: 9, height: 9,
        fill: "#7C8798"
      });
      g.append(line, leftCap, rightCap, point);
      svg.appendChild(g);
      if (animateRow) {
        const totalLength = Math.max(1, x(row.hi) - x(row.lo));
        line.style.opacity = "0";
        line.style.strokeDasharray = `${totalLength} ${totalLength}`;
        line.style.strokeDashoffset = totalLength;
        line.style.transition = "opacity 1ms linear 20ms, stroke-dashoffset 380ms ease 20ms";
        leftCap.style.opacity = "0";
        rightCap.style.opacity = "0";
        point.style.transformOrigin = `${x(row.yi)}px ${y}px`;
        point.style.transform = "scale(0.72)";
        leftCap.style.transition = "opacity 140ms ease 220ms";
        rightCap.style.transition = "opacity 140ms ease 220ms";
        point.style.transition = "transform 220ms ease";
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          line.style.opacity = "1";
          line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          leftCap.style.opacity = "1";
          rightCap.style.opacity = "1";
          point.style.transform = "scale(1)";
        });
      }
    }

    if (visibleRows > 0) {
      const fit = history[Math.max(0, visibleRows - 1)];
      const pg = make("g", { opacity: "1" });
      const pLine = make("line", {
        x1: x(fit.muLo), x2: x(fit.muHi), y1: posteriorY, y2: posteriorY,
        stroke: "#2774AE", "stroke-width": "3.5", "stroke-linecap": "round"
      });
      const pPoint = make("circle", {
        cx: x(fit.muMean), cy: posteriorY, r: 6.5, fill: "#2774AE"
      });
      const pLabel = make("text", {
        x: 28, y: posteriorY + 4, "font-size": "10.5", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#003B5C"
      }, "μ");
      pg.append(pLabel, pLine, pPoint);
      svg.appendChild(pg);
      if (animate) {
        const prevFit = history[Math.max(0, visibleRows - 2)];
        if (prevFit) {
          pLine.setAttribute("x1", x(prevFit.muLo));
          pLine.setAttribute("x2", x(prevFit.muHi));
          pPoint.setAttribute("cx", x(prevFit.muMean));
          pLine.style.transition = "x1 260ms ease, x2 260ms ease";
          pPoint.style.transition = "cx 260ms ease";
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            pLine.setAttribute("x1", x(fit.muLo));
            pLine.setAttribute("x2", x(fit.muHi));
            pPoint.setAttribute("cx", x(fit.muMean));
          });
        }
      }
    }

    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: plotBottom, y2: plotBottom,
      stroke: "#647990", "stroke-width": "2"
    }));
    [-1.0, -0.5, 0.0].forEach((tick) => {
      const tx = x(tick);
      svg.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: tx, x2: tx, y1: plotBottom, y2: plotBottom + 5,
        stroke: "#647990", "stroke-width": "1.5"
      }));
      svg.appendChild(make("text", {
        x: tx, y: plotBottom + 18, "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "10.5", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#5f7897"
      }, fmt(tick)));
    });
    return root.appendChild(svg);
  };

  const resolve = () => {
    const slide = root.closest("section");
    if (!slide || !slide.classList.contains("present")) return;
    const panel = root.closest(".fragment");
    if (panel && !panel.classList.contains("visible")) {
      draw(0, false);
      return;
    }
    let visibleRows = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i <= studies.length; i++) {
      if (slide.querySelector(`#combined-model-frag-${i}.visible`)) visibleRows = i;
    }
    const previous = Number(root.dataset.step || "0");
    const animate = visibleRows > previous;
    root.dataset.step = String(visibleRows);
    draw(visibleRows, animate);
  };

  const onFragment = (event) => {
    const slide = root.closest("section");
    if (slide && slide.contains(event.fragment)) resolve();
  };
  const onSlideChanged = () => resolve();
  const bindReveal = () => {
    if (typeof Reveal === "undefined" || typeof Reveal.on !== "function") return false;
    if (root.dataset.revealBound === "true") return true;
    Reveal.on("fragmentshown", onFragment);
    Reveal.on("fragmenthidden", onFragment);
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", onSlideChanged);
    root.dataset.revealBound = "true";
    resolve();
    return true;
  };
  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (bindReveal()) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (bindReveal()) window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, 120);
  };
  draw(0, false);
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }
})();
</script>
```

## Depression: the main signals {.auto-animate}

::: {style="margin-top: 10px;"}
<div id="depress-forest-sequence" style="width:100%;"></div>
<div id="depress-forest-fragments" style="display:none;">
<span id="depress-frag-1" class="fragment"></span>
<span id="depress-frag-2" class="fragment"></span>
</div>
:::

::: notes
Vitamin D is the most stable signal because its interval excludes zero with more support. Selenium also excludes zero, but the evidence base is much sparser, so it is intriguing rather than practice-informing. 2 studies with only 122 people. Also τ = 0.45, 95% CrI: 0.29 to 0.63, so there is large heterogeneity across studies.

Selenium may affect depression symptoms through multiple mechanisms, including antioxidant activity via selenoenzymes, modulation of neurotransmitter systems, anti-inflammatory effects, and regulation of neuronal signaling pathways

Vitamin B6 affects depression symptoms primarily through its role as a cofactor in neurotransmitter synthesis, particularly as pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP), the active coenzyme form that is essential for producing serotonin, dopamine, norepinephrine, and GABA.

The primary mechanism involves vitamin D receptor signaling in the central nervous system. VDR is widely expressed in brain regions critical for mood regulation, including the hippocampus, hypothalamus, and prefrontal cortex.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const mount = document.getElementById("depress-forest-sequence");
  if (!mount || mount.dataset.ready === "true") return;
  mount.dataset.ready = "true";

  const slide = mount.closest("section");
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  let timers = [];
  let currentStage = 0;

  const rows = [
    {label: "B1", estimate: -0.60, lo: -1.68, hi: 0.51},
    {label: "B12, B6, B9", estimate: 0.13, lo: -0.50, hi: 0.77},
    {label: "B12, B9", estimate: -0.11, lo: -0.76, hi: 0.53},
    {label: "B12, B9, D", estimate: -0.15, lo: -1.04, hi: 0.73},
    {label: "B6", estimate: -0.92, lo: -2.27, hi: 0.41},
    {label: "B9", estimate: -0.09, lo: -1.01, hi: 0.84},
    {label: "B9, Iron", estimate: 0.03, lo: -1.23, hi: 1.33},
    {label: "C", estimate: -0.12, lo: -1.14, hi: 0.90},
    {label: "D", estimate: -0.32, lo: -0.51, hi: -0.13},
    {label: "D, Iron", estimate: -0.58, lo: -1.65, hi: 0.51},
    {label: "Magnesium", estimate: -0.23, lo: -0.94, hi: 0.51},
    {label: "Magnesium, Zinc", estimate: -0.30, lo: -1.22, hi: 0.67},
    {label: "Selenium", estimate: -0.99, lo: -1.90, hi: -0.11},
    {label: "Zinc", estimate: -0.22, lo: -0.98, hi: 0.55}
  ];

  const stageConfigs = {
    1: { visible: new Set(["D"]), dim: new Set(), focus: ["D"], zoom: 1.82, tx: 46, ty: -2, duration: 1220, valueScreenX: 820 },
    2: { visible: new Set(["D", "Selenium"]), dim: new Set(["D"]), focus: ["D", "Selenium"], zoom: 1.46, tx: 34, ty: 0, duration: 1280, valueScreenX: 900 },
    3: { visible: new Set(rows.map((r) => r.label)), dim: new Set(), focus: ["D", "Selenium"], zoom: 1.0, tx: 0, ty: 0, duration: 1120, valueScreenX: 900 }
  };

  const width = 1100;
  const height = 500;
  const xMin = -2.5;
  const xMax = 1.5;
  const margin = { top: 28, right: 230, bottom: 70, left: 210 };
  const plotLeft = margin.left;
  const plotRight = width - margin.right;
  const plotTop = 88;
  const plotBottom = height - 88;
  const rowStep = 24;
  const rowsTop = 90;
  const centerX = 505;
  const centerY = 198;
  const focusLabelScreenX = 96;
  const focusValueScreenX = 900;

  const fmt = (x) => (x < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2);
  const scaleLinear = (min, max, lo, hi) => (value) => lo + ((value - min) / (max - min)) * (hi - lo);
  const x = scaleLinear(xMin, xMax, plotLeft, plotRight);
  const rowY = (i) => rowsTop + i * rowStep;
  const make = (tag, attrs = {}, text) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([key, value]) => el.setAttribute(key, value));
    if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
    return el;
  };

  const svg = make("svg", {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
    style: "display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;"
  });
  svg.appendChild(make("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width, height, fill: "#fff" }));
  const defs = make("defs");
  const zeroClip = make("clipPath", { id: "depress-zero-clip" });
  zeroClip.appendChild(make("rect", {
    x: plotLeft - 4, y: plotTop - 8,
    width: plotRight - plotLeft + 8, height: plotBottom - plotTop + 16
  }));
  defs.appendChild(zeroClip);
  svg.appendChild(defs);

  svg.appendChild(make("text", {
    x: plotLeft, y: 24, "font-size": "16", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#111"
  }, "Intervention"));
  svg.appendChild(make("text", {
    x: plotRight - 8, y: 24, "text-anchor": "end", "font-size": "16", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#111"
  }, "Effect Size (95% CrI)"));
  svg.appendChild(make("line", {
    x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: 34, y2: 34, stroke: "#111", "stroke-width": "1.6"
  }));

  const axisGroup = make("g");
  const axisRefs = [];
  const ticks = [-2, -1, 0, 1];
  ticks.forEach((tick) => {
    const xx = x(tick);
    const tickLine = make("line", {
      x1: xx, x2: xx, y1: height - 58, y2: height - 52,
      stroke: "#5e6b78", "stroke-width": "1.5"
    });
    const tickText = make("text", {
      x: xx, y: height - 36, "text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": "15", fill: "#47515b"
    }, fmt(tick));
    axisGroup.appendChild(tickLine);
    axisGroup.appendChild(tickText);
    axisRefs.push({ type: "tickLine", tick, el: tickLine }, { type: "tickText", tick, el: tickText });
  });
  const axisBaseLine = make("line", {
    x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: height - 58, y2: height - 58,
    stroke: "#5e6b78", "stroke-width": "1.5"
  });
  axisGroup.appendChild(axisBaseLine);
  axisRefs.push({ type: "base", el: axisBaseLine });
  svg.appendChild(axisGroup);
  const leftDir = make("text", {
    x: plotLeft, y: height - 18, "text-anchor": "start", "font-size": "13", fill: "#5f7897", "font-weight": "600",
    opacity: "0"
  }, "← Favors supplement");
  const rightDir = make("text", {
    x: plotRight, y: height - 18, "text-anchor": "end", "font-size": "13", fill: "#5f7897", "font-weight": "600",
    opacity: "0"
  }, "Favors placebo →");
  svg.appendChild(leftDir);
  svg.appendChild(rightDir);

  const plotGroup = make("g");
  const rowsGroup = make("g");
  const rowRefs = new Map();
  rows.forEach((row, i) => {
    const y = rowY(i);
    const isD = row.label === "D";
    const isS = row.label === "Selenium";
    const accent = isD ? "#5b8fd1" : isS ? "#6d57b5" : "#9aa0a6";

    const group = make("g", {
      opacity: "0",
      style: "transform: translateY(8px); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left center;"
    });
    const bg = make("rect", {
      x: plotLeft - 18, y: y - 12, width: plotRight - plotLeft + 36, height: 20,
      fill: isD ? "#eef4fb" : isS ? "#f2ecfb" : "#fbfcfd", opacity: "1"
    });
    const label = make("text", {
      x: plotLeft - 8, y: y + 4, "text-anchor": "end",
      "font-size": "16", "font-weight": (isD || isS) ? "700" : "500",
      fill: (isD || isS) ? accent : "#2f3f4f", opacity: "1"
    }, row.label);

    const lineLen = Math.max(1, x(row.hi) - x(row.lo));
    const line = make("line", {
      x1: x(row.lo), x2: x(row.hi), y1: y, y2: y,
      stroke: accent, "stroke-width": (isD || isS) ? "4" : "3",
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      "stroke-dasharray": `${lineLen} ${lineLen}`,
      "stroke-dashoffset": `${lineLen}`
    });
    const capLo = make("line", {
      x1: x(row.lo), x2: x(row.lo), y1: y - 6, y2: y + 6,
      stroke: accent, "stroke-width": (isD || isS) ? "3" : "2", opacity: "0"
    });
    const capHi = make("line", {
      x1: x(row.hi), x2: x(row.hi), y1: y - 6, y2: y + 6,
      stroke: accent, "stroke-width": (isD || isS) ? "3" : "2", opacity: "0"
    });
    const point = make("circle", {
      cx: x(row.estimate), cy: y, r: "0.1",
      fill: accent, opacity: "0"
    });
    const valueText = `${fmt(row.estimate)} (${fmt(row.lo)}, ${fmt(row.hi)})`;
    const valueBg = make("rect", {
      x: plotRight - 12, y: y - 12, width: "10", height: "22",
      rx: "4", fill: "#ffffff", opacity: "0.94"
    });
    const value = make("text", {
      x: plotRight - 12, y: y + 4, "text-anchor": "end", "font-size": "16",
      "font-weight": (isD || isS) ? "700" : "500",
      fill: (isD || isS) ? "#111" : "#4a4a4a", opacity: "1"
    }, valueText);

    group.appendChild(bg);
    group.appendChild(label);
    group.appendChild(line);
    group.appendChild(capLo);
    group.appendChild(capHi);
    group.appendChild(point);
    group.appendChild(valueBg);
    group.appendChild(value);
    rowsGroup.appendChild(group);
    rowRefs.set(row.label, { group, bg, label, line, capLo, capHi, point, valueBg, value, valueText, accent, isD, isS, row });
  });
  const zeroLine = make("line", {
    x1: x(0), x2: x(0), y1: plotTop - 8, y2: plotBottom,
    stroke: "#9aa0a6", "stroke-width": "2", "stroke-dasharray": "5,5",
    "clip-path": "url(#depress-zero-clip)"
  });
  plotGroup.appendChild(rowsGroup);
  svg.appendChild(plotGroup);
  svg.appendChild(zeroLine);

  mount.replaceChildren(svg);

  const clearTimers = () => {
    timers.forEach((t) => window.clearTimeout(t));
    timers = [];
  };

  const stageTransform = (stage) => {
    const cfg = stageConfigs[stage];
    if (stage === 3) return { zoom: 1, tx: 0, ty: 0 };
    const focusRows = cfg.focus.map((label) => rows.find((r) => r.label === label)).filter(Boolean);
    const avgX = focusRows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + x(r.estimate), 0) / focusRows.length;
    const avgY = focusRows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + rowY(rows.findIndex((d) => d.label === r.label)), 0) / focusRows.length;
    const tx = centerX - cfg.zoom * avgX + cfg.tx;
    const ty = centerY - cfg.zoom * avgY + cfg.ty;
    return { zoom: cfg.zoom, tx, ty };
  };

  const transformForStage = (stage) => {
    const t = stageTransform(stage);
    return stage === 3 ? "" : `translate(${t.tx.toFixed(2)} ${t.ty.toFixed(2)}) scale(${t.zoom.toFixed(4)})`;
  };

  const resetGeometry = () => {
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const ref = rowRefs.get(row.label);
      const len = Math.max(1, x(row.hi) - x(row.lo));
      ref.line.style.transition = "none";
      ref.line.style.strokeDashoffset = String(len);
      ref.capLo.style.transition = "none";
      ref.capHi.style.transition = "none";
      ref.point.style.transition = "none";
      ref.capLo.style.opacity = "0";
      ref.capHi.style.opacity = "0";
      ref.point.style.opacity = "0";
      ref.point.setAttribute("r", "0.1");
    });
  };

  const applyStage = (stage, animateRows = true, animateTransform = true) => {
    const cfg = stageConfigs[stage];
    const t = stageTransform(stage);
    plotGroup.style.transition = animateTransform ? `transform ${Math.round(cfg.duration * 1.18)}ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1)` : "none";
    plotGroup.setAttribute("transform", transformForStage(stage));
    zeroLine.style.transition = animateTransform ? `x1 ${Math.round(cfg.duration * 1.18)}ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1), x2 ${Math.round(cfg.duration * 1.18)}ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1)` : "none";
    const zeroX = t.tx + t.zoom * x(0);
    zeroLine.setAttribute("x1", zeroX.toFixed(2));
    zeroLine.setAttribute("x2", zeroX.toFixed(2));
    const axisLeft = t.tx + t.zoom * plotLeft;
    const axisRight = t.tx + t.zoom * plotRight;
    axisRefs.forEach((ref) => {
      ref.el.style.transition = animateTransform
        ? `${ref.type === "base" ? "x1" : "x1"} ${Math.round(cfg.duration * 1.18)}ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1), ${ref.type === "base" ? "x2" : "x2"} ${Math.round(cfg.duration * 1.18)}ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1), opacity 260ms ease`
        : "none";
      ref.el.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
      if (ref.type === "base") {
        ref.el.setAttribute("x1", axisLeft.toFixed(2));
        ref.el.setAttribute("x2", axisRight.toFixed(2));
      } else if (ref.type === "tickLine") {
        const xx = t.tx + t.zoom * x(ref.tick);
        ref.el.setAttribute("x1", xx.toFixed(2));
        ref.el.setAttribute("x2", xx.toFixed(2));
      } else if (ref.type === "tickText") {
        const xx = t.tx + t.zoom * x(ref.tick);
        ref.el.setAttribute("x", xx.toFixed(2));
      }
    });
    leftDir.style.transition = "opacity 340ms ease";
    rightDir.style.transition = "opacity 340ms ease";
    leftDir.style.opacity = stage === 3 ? "1" : "0";
    rightDir.style.opacity = stage === 3 ? "1" : "0";

    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const ref = rowRefs.get(row.label);
      const visible = cfg.visible.has(row.label);
      const dim = cfg.dim.has(row.label);
      const opacity = !visible ? 0 : dim ? 0.38 : 1;
      const focusLabel = stage < 3 && visible && (ref.isD || ref.isS);
      const valueWidth = Math.max(78, ref.valueText.length * 8.7 + 18);
      const localFocusLabelX = (focusLabel ? (focusLabelScreenX - t.tx) / t.zoom : plotLeft - 8);
      const localFocusValueX = stage < 3 ? (((cfg.valueScreenX || focusValueScreenX) - t.tx) / t.zoom) : plotRight + 18;
      const valueX = localFocusValueX;
      const valueAnchor = stage < 3 ? "start" : "start";
      const bgX = valueX - 8;
      ref.group.style.transition = animateRows ? "opacity 620ms ease, transform 980ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1)" : "none";
      ref.group.style.opacity = String(opacity);
      ref.group.style.transform = visible ? "translateY(0px)" : "translateY(8px)";
      ref.bg.setAttribute("opacity", visible ? (dim ? "0.55" : "1") : "0");
      ref.label.style.transition = animateRows ? "opacity 520ms ease, x 980ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1)" : "none";
      ref.label.setAttribute("x", String(localFocusLabelX));
      ref.label.setAttribute("text-anchor", focusLabel ? "start" : "end");
      ref.label.setAttribute("opacity", visible ? String(opacity) : "0");
      ref.valueBg.style.transition = animateRows ? "opacity 520ms ease, x 980ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1)" : "none";
      ref.valueBg.setAttribute("x", String(bgX));
      ref.valueBg.setAttribute("width", String(valueWidth + 16));
      ref.valueBg.setAttribute("opacity", visible ? String(Math.min(0.96, opacity === 1 ? 0.96 : 0.82)) : "0");
      ref.value.style.transition = animateRows ? "opacity 520ms ease, x 980ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.78, 0.18, 1)" : "none";
      ref.value.setAttribute("x", String(valueX));
      ref.value.setAttribute("text-anchor", valueAnchor);
      ref.value.setAttribute("opacity", visible ? String(opacity) : "0");
      ref.line.setAttribute("opacity", visible ? String(opacity) : "0");
      ref.capLo.setAttribute("opacity", visible && ref.capLo.style.opacity !== "0" ? String(opacity) : ref.capLo.style.opacity);
      ref.capHi.setAttribute("opacity", visible && ref.capHi.style.opacity !== "0" ? String(opacity) : ref.capHi.style.opacity);
      ref.point.setAttribute("opacity", visible && ref.point.style.opacity !== "0" ? String(opacity) : ref.point.style.opacity);
    });
  };

  const revealRow = (label, delay = 0) => {
    const ref = rowRefs.get(label);
    if (!ref) return;
    const show = () => {
      const row = rows.find((r) => r.label === label);
      const len = Math.max(1, x(row.hi) - x(row.lo));
      ref.line.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset 760ms ease, opacity 320ms ease";
      ref.line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
      const t1 = window.setTimeout(() => {
        ref.capLo.style.transition = "opacity 220ms ease";
        ref.capHi.style.transition = "opacity 220ms ease";
        ref.capLo.style.opacity = ref.group.style.opacity || "1";
        ref.capHi.style.opacity = ref.group.style.opacity || "1";
        ref.point.style.transition = "opacity 260ms ease, r 460ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)";
        ref.point.style.opacity = ref.group.style.opacity || "1";
        ref.point.setAttribute("r", (ref.isD || ref.isS) ? "6.5" : "5");
      }, 280);
      timers.push(t1);
    };
    const t0 = window.setTimeout(show, delay);
    timers.push(t0);
  };

  const materializeUpToStage = (stage) => {
    clearTimers();
    resetGeometry();
    applyStage(stage, false, false);
    const visibleRows = stage === 1
      ? ["D"]
      : stage === 2
        ? ["D", "Selenium"]
        : rows.map((r) => r.label);
    visibleRows.forEach((label) => {
      const ref = rowRefs.get(label);
      const row = rows.find((r) => r.label === label);
      const len = Math.max(1, x(row.hi) - x(row.lo));
      ref.line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
      const opacity = ref.group.style.opacity || "1";
      ref.capLo.style.opacity = opacity;
      ref.capHi.style.opacity = opacity;
      ref.point.style.opacity = opacity;
      ref.point.setAttribute("r", (ref.isD || ref.isS) ? "6.5" : "5");
      ref.line.setAttribute("opacity", opacity);
    });
  };

  const advanceToStage = (stage) => {
    clearTimers();
    if (stage <= currentStage) {
      currentStage = stage;
      materializeUpToStage(stage);
      return;
    }

    if (currentStage === 0 && stage === 1) {
      applyStage(1, false, true);
      revealRow("D", 120);
      currentStage = 1;
      return;
    }

    if (currentStage <= 1 && stage === 2) {
      if (currentStage === 0) materializeUpToStage(1);
      applyStage(2, true, true);
      revealRow("Selenium", 260);
      currentStage = 2;
      return;
    }

    if (stage === 3) {
      if (currentStage === 0) materializeUpToStage(2);
      if (currentStage === 1) materializeUpToStage(2);
      applyStage(3, true, true);
      rows.filter((r) => !["D", "Selenium"].includes(r.label)).forEach((row, idx) => {
        revealRow(row.label, 180 + idx * 70);
      });
      currentStage = 3;
    }
  };

  const resolveStage = () => {
    if (!slide || !slide.classList.contains("present")) return;
    let stage = 1;
    if (slide.querySelector("#depress-frag-1.visible")) stage = 2;
    if (slide.querySelector("#depress-frag-2.visible")) stage = 3;
    advanceToStage(stage);
  };

  const renderInactive = () => {
    currentStage = 0;
    materializeUpToStage(3);
  };

  const bindReveal = () => {
    const onFragment = (event) => {
      if (slide && slide.contains(event.fragment)) resolveStage();
    };
    const onSlideChanged = () => {
      if (slide?.classList.contains("present")) {
        currentStage = 0;
        resetGeometry();
        resolveStage();
      } else {
        renderInactive();
      }
    };
    window.Reveal.on("ready", onSlideChanged);
    window.Reveal.on("fragmentshown", onFragment);
    window.Reveal.on("fragmenthidden", onFragment);
    window.Reveal.on("slidechanged", onSlideChanged);
    if (slide?.classList.contains("present")) {
      currentStage = 0;
      resetGeometry();
      resolveStage();
    } else {
      renderInactive();
    }
  };

  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (window.Reveal && typeof window.Reveal.on === "function") {
      bindReveal();
    } else {
      timers.push(window.setTimeout(waitForReveal, 120));
    }
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }
})();
</script>
```

## Does baseline deficiency change the picture for vitamin D?

::: {style="margin-top: 0;"}
<div id="vitd-deficiency-forest" style="width:100%;"></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const mount = document.getElementById("vitd-deficiency-forest");
  if (!mount) return;
  const slide = mount.closest("section");
  let timers = [];

  const data = [
    { depressed: "No", deficiency: "Unknown", defKey: "unknown", estimate: -0.01, lo: -0.86, hi: 0.76 },
    { depressed: "No", deficiency: "Not deficient", defKey: "no", estimate: -0.13, lo: -0.49, hi: 0.23 },
    { depressed: "No", deficiency: "Deficient", defKey: "yes", estimate: 0.03, lo: -0.37, hi: 0.44 },
    { depressed: "Yes", deficiency: "Unknown", defKey: "unknown", estimate: -1.03, lo: -1.91, hi: -0.16 },
    { depressed: "Yes", deficiency: "Not deficient", defKey: "no", estimate: -0.50, lo: -1.11, hi: 0.09 },
    { depressed: "Yes", deficiency: "Deficient", defKey: "yes", estimate: -0.49, lo: -0.74, hi: -0.25 }
  ];

  const defColors = {
    unknown: "#9aa0a6",
    no: "#4f7fc4",
    yes: "#5d4aa6"
  };

  const width = 1040;
  const height = 414;
  const plotTop = 84;
  const rowStep = 42;
  const groupGap = 18;
  const xMin = -2.15;
  const xMax = 0.95;
  const depressionX = 28;
  const rowLabelX = 178;
  const plotX0 = 352;
  const plotX1 = 970;
  const axisY = 326;
  const renderDelay = 260;

  const make = (tag, attrs = {}, text) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([key, value]) => el.setAttribute(key, value));
    if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
    return el;
  };

  const xScale = (x) => plotX0 + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * (plotX1 - plotX0);
  const rowY = (index) => plotTop + index * rowStep;
  const clearTimers = () => {
    timers.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id));
    timers = [];
  };
  const fmt = (x) => (x < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2);

  const render = (animate = false) => {
    clearTimers();
    const svg = make("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      style: "display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;"
    });
    svg.appendChild(make("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width, height, fill: "#fff" }));
    const tooltip = make("g", { opacity: "0", style: "pointer-events:none;" });
    const tooltipBg = make("rect", {
      x: 0, y: 0, width: "120", height: "42", rx: "7",
      fill: "#ffffff", stroke: "#cfd8e3", "stroke-width": "1.1",
      opacity: "0.98"
    });
    const tooltipText = make("text", {
      x: 10, y: 18, "font-size": "13", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#223446"
    });
    const tooltipText2 = make("text", {
      x: 10, y: 33, "font-size": "12", fill: "#4b5d70"
    });
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipBg);
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipText);
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipText2);

    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: plotX0, x2: plotX1, y1: axisY, y2: axisY,
      stroke: "#d7dee7", "stroke-width": "1.2"
    }));
    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: xScale(0), x2: xScale(0), y1: plotTop - 10, y2: axisY,
      stroke: "#6f7d8c", "stroke-width": "1.6", "stroke-dasharray": "4,4"
    }));

    [-2, -1, 0, 1].forEach((tick) => {
      const x = xScale(tick);
      svg.appendChild(make("line", {
        x1: x, x2: x, y1: axisY, y2: axisY + 6,
        stroke: "#64707c", "stroke-width": "1.2"
      }));
      svg.appendChild(make("text", {
        x, y: axisY + 24, "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "14", fill: "#4a5560"
      }, String(tick)));
    });

    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: (plotX0 + plotX1) / 2, y: axisY + 46, "text-anchor": "middle",
      "font-size": "14", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#222"
    }, "SMD"));

    const rowAnimations = [];
    let pinnedTooltip = null;
    const showTooltip = (row, xMean, yMid) => {
      const text1 = `${fmt(row.estimate)} (${fmt(row.lo)}, ${fmt(row.hi)})`;
      const text2 = `${row.depressed === "Yes" ? "Depressed" : "Not depressed"} • ${row.deficiency}`;
      tooltipText.textContent = text1;
      tooltipText2.textContent = text2;
      const boxWidth = Math.max(178, text1.length * 7.9 + 24, text2.length * 6.4 + 24);
      const desiredX = Math.min(width - boxWidth - 8, Math.max(plotX0 + 12, xMean + 18));
      const desiredY = Math.max(18, yMid - 34);
      tooltipBg.setAttribute("width", String(boxWidth));
      tooltip.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${desiredX} ${desiredY})`);
      tooltip.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
    };
    const hideTooltip = () => {
      if (pinnedTooltip) return;
      tooltip.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
    };
    const defOrder = ["Unknown", "Not deficient", "Deficient"];
    const groupMeta = [
      { label: "Depressed: No", color: "#5f79a4", start: 0, offset: 0 },
      { label: "Depressed: Yes", color: "#d96862", start: 3, offset: groupGap }
    ];

    groupMeta.forEach((group) => {
      svg.appendChild(make("text", {
        x: depressionX, y: rowY(group.start) - 12 + group.offset, "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "17", "font-weight": "700", fill: group.color
      }, group.label));

      defOrder.forEach((defLabel, i) => {
        const row = data[group.start + i];
        const y = rowY(group.start + i) + group.offset;
        const g = make("g", {
          style: `opacity:${animate ? 0 : 1};transition:opacity 360ms ease;`
        });

        const yMid = y + 8;
        const color = defColors[row.defKey];
        const xLo = xScale(row.lo);
        const xHi = xScale(row.hi);
        const xMean = xScale(row.estimate);
        const lineLen = Math.max(1, xHi - xLo);
        g.appendChild(make("text", {
          x: rowLabelX, y: y + 4, "text-anchor": "start",
          "font-size": "15", "font-weight": "600",
          fill: row.defKey === "yes" ? "#5d4aa6" : row.defKey === "no" ? "#4f7fc4" : "#7c838b"
        }, defLabel));
        const line = make("line", {
          x1: xLo, x2: xHi, y1: yMid, y2: yMid,
          stroke: color, "stroke-width": "3", "stroke-linecap": "round",
          "stroke-dasharray": `${lineLen} ${lineLen}`,
          "stroke-dashoffset": animate ? `${lineLen}` : "0"
        });
        const capLo = make("line", {
          x1: xLo, x2: xLo, y1: yMid - 5.5, y2: yMid + 5.5,
          stroke: color, "stroke-width": "1.6", opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
        });
        const capHi = make("line", {
          x1: xHi, x2: xHi, y1: yMid - 5.5, y2: yMid + 5.5,
          stroke: color, "stroke-width": "1.6", opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
        });
        const pointRadius = row.defKey === "yes" ? 6.2 : 5.1;
        const point = make("circle", {
          cx: xMean, cy: yMid, r: animate ? "0.1" : String(pointRadius),
          fill: color, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": "1.1",
          opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
        });
        g.appendChild(line);
        g.appendChild(capLo);
        g.appendChild(capHi);
        g.appendChild(point);
        g.style.cursor = "pointer";
        const hot = make("rect", {
          x: plotX0 - 12, y: yMid - 14, width: plotX1 - plotX0 + 24, height: 28,
          fill: "#ffffff", opacity: "0.001"
        });
        hot.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showTooltip(row, xMean, yMid));
        hot.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideTooltip);
        hot.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (pinnedTooltip === row) {
            pinnedTooltip = null;
            tooltip.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
          } else {
            pinnedTooltip = row;
            showTooltip(row, xMean, yMid);
          }
        });
        g.appendChild(hot);
        svg.appendChild(g);
        rowAnimations.push({
          g, line, capLo, capHi, point, pointRadius,
          delay: group.start === 0 ? i * 340 : 1400 + i * 340
        });
      });
    });

    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: plotX0, y: axisY + 40, "text-anchor": "start",
      "font-size": "13", fill: "#5b6570"
    }, "← favors vitamin D / supplement"));
    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: plotX1, y: axisY + 40, "text-anchor": "end",
      "font-size": "13", fill: "#5b6570"
    }, "favors placebo →"));
    svg.appendChild(tooltip);

    mount.replaceChildren(svg);

    if (!animate) return;

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rowAnimations.forEach((part, i) => {
        const showId = window.setTimeout(() => {
          part.g.style.opacity = "1";
          part.line.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset 880ms ease";
          part.line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          const finishId = window.setTimeout(() => {
            part.capLo.style.transition = "opacity 220ms ease";
            part.capHi.style.transition = "opacity 220ms ease";
            part.capLo.style.opacity = "1";
            part.capHi.style.opacity = "1";
            part.point.style.transition = "r 620ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), opacity 320ms ease";
            part.point.setAttribute("r", String(part.pointRadius));
            part.point.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
          }, 420);
          timers.push(finishId);
        }, renderDelay + part.delay + i * 20);
        timers.push(showId);
      });
    });
  };

  const activate = () => {
    if (slide && !slide.classList.contains("present")) {
      render(false);
      return;
    }
    render(true);
  };

  const bindReveal = () => {
    if (typeof Reveal === "undefined" || typeof Reveal.on !== "function") return false;
    Reveal.on("ready", activate);
    if (!window.__vitdDeficiencyForestBound) {
      Reveal.on("slidechanged", activate);
      window.__vitdDeficiencyForestBound = true;
    }
    return true;
  };

  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (bindReveal()) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (bindReveal()) window.clearInterval(timer);
    }, 120);
    timers.push(timer);
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }

  activate();
})();
</script>
:::

::: notes
"We had reported a mean drug-placebo difference of 1.80 points on the HAM-D and a standardized mean difference (SMD) of 0.32. The differences reported in the replications ranged from 1.62 to 2.56 HAM-D points, with SMD effect sizes ranging from 0.23 to 0.34. To put this into perspective, the NICE criteria for clinical significance of antidepressant-placebo differences are three points on the HAM-D or SMDs of at least 0.50, corresponding to what Cohen (17) proposed as a moderate effect size." https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychiatry/articles/10.3389/fpsyt.2019.00407/full?trk=public_post_comment-text
:::

## The deficiency-informed framework

::: {style="margin-top: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #fff8e8; border-left: 4px solid #FFD100; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.82em; line-height: 1.35; color: #4a4a4a;"}
<strong style="color:#003B5C;">Important caveat:</strong> this is <strong>study-level</strong>, not patient-level evidence. The subgroup pattern is clinically suggestive, but it does <em>not</em> prove that an individual patient will benefit simply because they are deficient.
:::

```{=html}
<div style="display: flex; gap: 36px; font-size: 0.88em; margin-top: 24px;">
  <div style="flex: 1; padding: 20px; background: #fff3cd; border-radius: 8px; border-top: 4px solid #FFD100;">
    <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05em; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #003B5C;">❌ Universal supplementation</div>
    <div class="fragment">Patient has depression</div>
    <div class="fragment">↓<br>Add micronutrients</div>
    <div class="fragment">↓<br>Assume benefit</div>
    <div class="fragment" style="margin-top: 16px;"><em style="color: #888;">What most trials implicitly test —<br>mixing deficient + replete patients</em></div>
  </div>
  <div style="flex: 1; padding: 20px; background: #e8f5e9; border-radius: 8px; border-top: 4px solid #2e7d32;">
    <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05em; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #003B5C;">✅ Deficiency-informed model</div>
    <div class="fragment">Patient has depression</div>
    <div class="fragment">↓<br><strong>Check levels first</strong></div>
    <div class="fragment">↓<br>Deficient → Correct deficiency</div>
    <div class="fragment">Replete → Evidence doesn't support supplementation</div>
    <div class="fragment" style="margin-top: 16px;"><em style="color: #888;">What the subgroup data support</em></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

::: notes
This is the conceptual contribution I'm most proud of. The reason the literature is hard to interpret is that most trials enroll whoever has depression — deficient and replete mixed together. When you average across those groups, you dilute the real signal from the deficient subgroup. The framework: check first, supplement if there's a biochemical reason to.
:::

## What about augmentation?

::: {style="margin-top: 8px;"}
<div id="augmentation-forest-stage" style="width:100%;"></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const mount = document.getElementById("augmentation-forest-stage");
  if (!mount) return;
  if (mount.dataset.ready === "true") return;
  mount.dataset.ready = "true";
  const slide = mount.closest("section");
  let timers = [];

  const rows = [
    { label: "Vit D + AD", estimate: -0.28, lo: -1.08, hi: 0.49 },
    { label: "B9 + AD", estimate: -0.55, lo: -1.23, hi: 0.19 },
    { label: "B6/B9/B12 + AD", estimate: -0.45, lo: -1.44, hi: 0.56 }
  ];

  const fmt = (x) => (x < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2);
  const width = 810;
  const height = 324;
  const margin = { top: 40, right: 18, bottom: 104, left: 180 };
  const xMin = -1.6;
  const xMax = 0.7;
  const plotLeft = margin.left;
  const plotRight = width - margin.right;
  const plotWidth = plotRight - plotLeft;
  const rowY = (i) => 98 + i * 56;
  const x = (value) => plotLeft + ((value - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * plotWidth;
  const make = (tag, attrs = {}, text) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([k, v]) => el.setAttribute(k, v));
    if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
    return el;
  };
  const clearTimers = () => {
    timers.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id));
    timers = [];
  };
  const build = (animate = false) => {
    clearTimers();

    const svg = make("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      style: "display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;"
    });
    let pinnedRow = null;

    svg.appendChild(make("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width, height, fill: "#fff" }));
    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: plotLeft, y: 22, "font-size": "15", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#111"
    }, "Augmentation studies"));
    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: 32, y2: 32, stroke: "#111", "stroke-width": "1.2"
    }));

    const axisY = 252;
    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: plotLeft, x2: plotRight, y1: axisY, y2: axisY,
      stroke: "#5f6f84", "stroke-width": "1.6"
    }));
    [-1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5].forEach((tick) => {
      const xx = x(tick);
      svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: xx, x2: xx, y1: axisY, y2: axisY + 7, stroke: "#5f6f84", "stroke-width": "1.4" }));
      svg.appendChild(make("text", { x: xx, y: axisY + 26, "text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": "15", fill: "#37485b" }, tick.toFixed(1)));
    });
    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: (plotLeft + plotRight) / 2, y: height - 8, "text-anchor": "middle",
      "font-size": "16", "font-weight": "700", fill: "#222"
    }, "SMD"));
    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: plotLeft, y: axisY + 56, "text-anchor": "start",
      "font-size": "15", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#5b6570"
    }, "← favors augmentation"));
    svg.appendChild(make("text", {
      x: plotRight, y: axisY + 56, "text-anchor": "end",
      "font-size": "15", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#5b6570"
    }, "favors placebo →"));

    const tooltip = make("g", { opacity: "0", style: "pointer-events:none;" });
    const tooltipBg = make("rect", {
      x: 0, y: 0, width: "120", height: "40", rx: "7",
      fill: "#ffffff", stroke: "#cfd8e3", "stroke-width": "1.1", opacity: "0.98"
    });
    const tooltipText = make("text", {
      x: 10, y: 17, "font-size": "13", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#223446"
    });
    const tooltipText2 = make("text", {
      x: 10, y: 31, "font-size": "12", fill: "#4b5d70"
    });
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipBg);
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipText);
    tooltip.appendChild(tooltipText2);

    const showTooltip = (row, xMean, y) => {
      const text1 = `${fmt(row.estimate)} (${fmt(row.lo)}, ${fmt(row.hi)})`;
      const text2 = row.label;
      tooltipText.textContent = text1;
      tooltipText2.textContent = text2;
      const boxWidth = Math.max(172, text1.length * 7.8 + 22, text2.length * 7 + 22);
      const tx = Math.min(width - boxWidth - 8, Math.max(plotLeft + 16, xMean + 18));
      const ty = Math.max(44, y - 38);
      tooltipBg.setAttribute("width", String(boxWidth));
      tooltip.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${tx} ${ty})`);
      tooltip.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
    };

    const hideTooltip = () => {
      if (pinnedRow) return;
      tooltip.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
    };

    const rowRefs = [];
    rows.forEach((row, i) => {
      const y = rowY(i);
      const rowFill = i % 2 === 0 ? "#fbfcfd" : "#ffffff";
      const rowGroup = make("g", {
        opacity: animate ? "0" : "1",
        style: "transform: translateY(7px); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left center;"
      });
      rowGroup.appendChild(make("rect", {

        fill: rowFill, opacity: "0.92"
      }));
      rowGroup.appendChild(make("text", {
        x: 28, y: y + 5, "font-size": "16", "font-weight": "600", fill: "#2f3f4f"
      }, row.label));

      const xLo = x(row.lo);
      const xHi = x(row.hi);

      });
      const capLo = make("line", {
