        stroke: "#2d5c91", "stroke-width": "2", opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
      });
      const capHi = make("line", {
        x1: xHi, x2: xHi, y1: y - 6.5, y2: y + 6.5,
        stroke: "#2d5c91", "stroke-width": "2", opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
      });
      const point = make("circle", {
        cx: xMean, cy: y, r: animate ? "0.1" : "5.8",
        fill: "#2d5c91", stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": "1.1", opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
      });
      rowGroup.appendChild(line);
      rowGroup.appendChild(capLo);
      rowGroup.appendChild(capHi);
      rowGroup.appendChild(point);
      const hot = make("rect", {
        x: plotLeft - 8, y: y - 15, width: plotWidth + 16, height: 30,
        fill: "#ffffff", opacity: "0.001"
      });
      hot.style.cursor = "pointer";
      hot.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showTooltip(row, xMean, y));
      hot.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideTooltip);
      hot.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (pinnedRow === row.label) {
          pinnedRow = null;
          tooltip.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
        } else {
          pinnedRow = row.label;
          showTooltip(row, xMean, y);
        }
      });
      rowGroup.appendChild(hot);

      svg.appendChild(rowGroup);
      rowRefs.push({ group: rowGroup, line, capLo, capHi, point });
    });

    svg.appendChild(make("line", {
      x1: x(0), x2: x(0), y1: 58, y2: axisY,
      stroke: "#666", "stroke-width": "1.4", "stroke-dasharray": "5,5"
    }));

    svg.appendChild(tooltip);

    mount.replaceChildren(svg);
    if (!animate) return;

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rowRefs.forEach((ref, i) => {
        const delay = 160 + i * 170;
        const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
          ref.group.style.transition = "opacity 260ms ease, transform 420ms ease";
          ref.group.style.opacity = "1";
          ref.group.style.transform = "translateY(0px)";
          ref.line.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset 420ms ease";
          ref.line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          const t2 = window.setTimeout(() => {
            ref.capLo.style.transition = "opacity 130ms ease";
            ref.capHi.style.transition = "opacity 130ms ease";
            ref.capLo.style.opacity = "1";
            ref.capHi.style.opacity = "1";
            ref.point.style.transition = "opacity 130ms ease, r 260ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)";
            ref.point.style.opacity = "1";
            ref.point.setAttribute("r", "5.8");
          }, 160);
          timers.push(t2);
        }, delay);
        timers.push(t);
      });
    });
  };

  const activate = () => {
    const active = !slide || slide.classList.contains("present");
    build(active);
  };

  const bindReveal = () => {
    if (!window.Reveal || typeof window.Reveal.on !== "function") return false;
    window.Reveal.on("ready", activate);
    if (!window.__augmentationForestRevealBound) {
      window.Reveal.on("slidechanged", activate);
      window.__augmentationForestRevealBound = true;
    }
    return true;
  };

  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (bindReveal()) return;
    timers.push(window.setTimeout(waitForReveal, 120));
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }

  activate();
})();
</script>
:::

::: {.fragment style="max-width: 760px; margin: 12px auto 0; padding: 12px 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfdff 0%, #f6f9fd 100%); border-left: 4px solid #2774AE; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.8em; line-height: 1.3; color: #32475f; text-align: left;"}
<strong style="color:#003B5C;">5 augmentation studies.</strong> These were modeled separately from the placebo-controlled network, and all credible intervals still cross zero, so the signal is suggestive rather than definitive.
:::

::: notes
5 studies used micronutrients as augmentation on top of antidepressants. We modeled these separately — can't compare vitamin D vs. placebo with vitamin D + antidepressant vs. antidepressant alone in the same network. Point estimates are in the right direction but every credible interval crosses zero. Worth watching, not actionable yet.
:::

---

## Anxiety: no clear signal {background-color="#fafafa"}

::: {style="margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 0.92em; text-align: center; color: #c0392b; font-weight: 700;"}
No micronutrient reached a credible interval excluding zero
:::

::: {style="margin-top: 10px;"}
<div id="anxiety-forest-stage" style="width: 100%;"></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const mount = document.getElementById("anxiety-forest-stage");
  if (!mount) return;
  if (mount.dataset.ready === "true") return;
  mount.dataset.ready = "true";
  const slide = mount.closest("section");
  let timers = [];

  const rows = [
    { label: "B12, B6, B9", estimate: -0.22, lo: -0.97, hi: 0.53 },
    { label: "D", estimate: -0.02, lo: -0.27, hi: 0.22, highlight: true },
    { label: "D, Iron", estimate: 0.08, lo: -0.81, hi: 0.99 },
    { label: "Magnesium", estimate: -0.11, lo: -1.12, hi: 0.92 },
    { label: "Magnesium, Zinc", estimate: -0.27, lo: -1.12, hi: 0.52 },
    { label: "Selenium", estimate: -0.24, lo: -0.79, hi: 0.48 },
    { label: "Zinc", estimate: 0.01, lo: -1.03, hi: 1.14 }
  ];

  const fmt = (x) => (x < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2);
  const width = 1060;
  const height = 540;
  const margin = { top: 18, right: 270, bottom: 92, left: 210 };
  const xMin = -1.25;
  const xMax = 1.25;
  const xSpan = width - margin.left - margin.right;
  const rowH = 52;
  const plotTop = 78;
  const plotBottom = plotTop + rowH * (rows.length - 1);
  const centerY = plotTop + rowH * (rows.length - 1) / 2;

  const scaleX = (x) => margin.left + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * xSpan;
  const rowY = (i) => plotTop + i * rowH;
  const make = (tag, attrs = {}, text) => {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([k, v]) => el.setAttribute(k, v));
    if (text != null) el.textContent = text;
    return el;
  };
  const clearTimers = () => {
    timers.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id));
    timers = [];
  };
  const text = (parent, x, y, value, attrs = {}) => {
    parent.appendChild(make("text", { x, y, ...attrs }, value));
  };

  const render = (animate = false) => {
    clearTimers();
    const svg = make("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      style: "display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;"
    });

    svg.appendChild(make("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width, height, fill: "#fafafa" }));

    const axisY = plotBottom + 18;
    svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: margin.left, x2: width - margin.right, y1: axisY, y2: axisY, stroke: "#7588a0", "stroke-width": "1.5" }));
    svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: scaleX(0), x2: scaleX(0), y1: plotTop - 22, y2: plotBottom + 22, stroke: "#6e6e6e", "stroke-width": "1.5", "stroke-dasharray": "7,6" }));

    const ticks = [-1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0];
    ticks.forEach((tick) => {
      const x = scaleX(tick);
      svg.appendChild(make("line", { x1: x, x2: x, y1: axisY, y2: axisY + 7, stroke: "#7588a0", "stroke-width": "1.4" }));
      text(svg, x, axisY + 25, tick.toFixed(1), {
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        "font-size": "15",
        fill: "#4a4a4a"
      });
    });
    text(svg, (margin.left + width - margin.right) / 2, height - 20, "SMD", {
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      "font-size": "17",
      "font-weight": "600",
      fill: "#222"
    });
    text(svg, margin.left - 18, height - 30, "Favors treatment", {
      "text-anchor": "start",
      "font-size": "14",
      "font-weight": "600",
      fill: "#6d7782"
    });
    text(svg, width - margin.right - 16, height - 30, "Favors placebo", {
      "text-anchor": "end",
      "font-size": "14",
      "font-weight": "600",
      fill: "#6d7782"
    });

    const rowRefs = [];
    rows.forEach((row, i) => {
      const y = rowY(i);
      const color = row.highlight ? "#2f4f74" : "#111";
      const weight = row.highlight ? "700" : "500";
      const rowGroup = make("g", {
        opacity: animate ? "0" : "1",
        style: "transform: translateY(7px); transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left center;"
      });
      if (i % 2 === 0) {
        rowGroup.appendChild(make("rect", {
          x: margin.left - 12, y: y - 26, width: width - margin.left - margin.right + 24, height: rowH,
          fill: "#ffffff", opacity: "0.32"
        }));
      }
      rowGroup.appendChild(make("text", {
        x: 40, y: y + 6, "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "18",
        "font-weight": weight,
        fill: color
      }, row.label));

      const xLo = scaleX(row.lo);
      const xHi = scaleX(row.hi);
      const xMean = scaleX(row.estimate);
      const lineLen = Math.max(1, xHi - xLo);
      const intervalGroup = make("g");
      const line = make("line", {
        x1: xLo, x2: xHi, y1: y, y2: y,
        stroke: "#111", "stroke-width": row.highlight ? "4.5" : "3",
        "stroke-linecap": "round",
        "stroke-dasharray": `${lineLen} ${lineLen}`,
        "stroke-dashoffset": animate ? `${lineLen}` : "0"
      });
      const capLo = make("line", {
        x1: xLo, x2: xLo, y1: y - 8, y2: y + 8,
        stroke: "#111", "stroke-width": row.highlight ? "3.5" : "2.2",
        opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
      });
      const capHi = make("line", {
        x1: xHi, x2: xHi, y1: y - 8, y2: y + 8,
        stroke: "#111", "stroke-width": row.highlight ? "3.5" : "2.2",
        opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
      });
      const point = make("circle", {
        cx: xMean, cy: y, r: animate ? "0.1" : String(row.highlight ? 7.5 : 6.5),
        fill: "#111", opacity: animate ? "0" : "1"
      });
      intervalGroup.appendChild(line);
      intervalGroup.appendChild(capLo);
      intervalGroup.appendChild(capHi);
      intervalGroup.appendChild(point);
      rowGroup.appendChild(intervalGroup);

      rowGroup.appendChild(make("text", {
        x: width - margin.right + 16, y: y + 6, "text-anchor": "start",
        "font-size": "16",
        "font-weight": weight,
        fill: "#222"
      }, `${fmt(row.estimate)} (${fmt(row.lo)}, ${fmt(row.hi)})`));
      svg.appendChild(rowGroup);
      rowRefs.push({ group: rowGroup, line, capLo, capHi, point, highlight: row.highlight });
    });

    mount.replaceChildren(svg);

    if (!animate) return;

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rowRefs.forEach((ref, idx) => {
        const delay = 180 + idx * 320;
        const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
          ref.group.style.transition = "opacity 260ms ease, transform 420ms ease";
          ref.group.style.opacity = "1";
          ref.group.style.transform = "translateY(0px)";
          ref.line.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset 840ms ease";
          ref.line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          const t2 = window.setTimeout(() => {
            ref.capLo.style.transition = "opacity 160ms ease";
            ref.capHi.style.transition = "opacity 160ms ease";
            ref.capLo.style.opacity = "1";
            ref.capHi.style.opacity = "1";
            ref.point.style.transition = "opacity 180ms ease, r 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)";
            ref.point.style.opacity = "1";
            ref.point.setAttribute("r", String(ref.highlight ? 7.5 : 6.5));
          }, 420);
          timers.push(t2);
        }, delay);
        timers.push(t);
      });
    });
  };

  const activate = () => {
    const active = !slide || slide.classList.contains("present");
    render(active);
  };

  const bindReveal = () => {
    if (!window.Reveal || typeof window.Reveal.on !== "function") return false;
    window.Reveal.on("ready", activate);
    if (!window.__anxietyForestRevealBound) {
      window.Reveal.on("slidechanged", activate);
      window.__anxietyForestRevealBound = true;
    }
    return true;
  };

  const waitForReveal = () => {
    if (bindReveal()) return;
    timers.push(window.setTimeout(waitForReveal, 120));
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", waitForReveal, { once: true });
  } else {
    waitForReveal();
  }

  activate();
})();
</script>
:::

::: notes
For anxiety, the picture is starker. Nothing crosses the line. The forest plot is much sparser — only 7 rows vs. 14 for depression. Selenium has the largest point estimate at −0.24 but the interval is wide. Vitamin D, which drove the depression signal, shows essentially no effect here. All comparisons were rated very low confidence by CINeMA. This may be an underpowered literature, not a definitive null.
:::

---

## Why anxiety might have lagged

::: {.incremental style="font-size: 0.95em; line-height: 2.4;"}
- Only **18 studies** assessed anxiety vs. **50** for depression
- Substantial heterogeneity (<strong><span class="tau-accent">τ</span></strong> = 0.34, 95% CrI: 0.05 to 0.68)
- Vitamin D — which drove the depression signal — showed **essentially no effect** on anxiety
- Most vitamin D trials enrolled older adults with depression, not anxiety disorders
:::

::: {.fragment style="margin-top: 28px; padding: 16px; background: #DAEBFE; border-left: 4px solid #2774AE; border-radius: 4px;"}
**The anxiety question is genuinely open** — underpowered literature, not a definitive null
:::

::: notes
The anxiety finding is less "micronutrients don't work for anxiety" and more "we haven't studied this well enough." Fewer trials, more heterogeneity, different participant profiles. The anxiety literature needs purpose-built trials.
:::

---

## Safety

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
::: {.incremental style="font-size: 0.95em; line-height: 2.2;"}
- No micronutrient was associated with
a credible increase in adverse events

- All odds ratio credible intervals
included the null

- Based on 33 of 50 low-RoB studies
(64.7%) with available safety data
:::
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}
::: {.fragment style="padding: 20px; background: #fff3cd; border-left: 4px solid #FFD100; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.88em;"}
- **"Seems safe" ≠ indiscriminate**

::: {.incremental}
- Vitamin D: hypercalcemia at high doses
- B6: neuropathy long-term at high dose
- Drug-nutrient interactions
- "Natural" ≠ harmless
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: notes
The safety picture is reassuring — no micronutrient associated with a credible increase in adverse events. But I want to push back on the framing that supplements are inherently benign. High-dose vitamin D can cause hypercalcemia. Long-term high-dose B6 has been linked to peripheral neuropathy. Clinical judgment still applies.
:::

---

## What this study is **not** saying

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="padding: 20px; background: #fff0f0; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.9em; border-top: 3px solid #C62828;"}
::: {.fragment}
❌ "Vitamins treat depression"
:::

::: {.fragment}
❌ "All supplements are useless"
:::

::: {.fragment}
❌ "Check levels on every patient"
:::

::: {.fragment}
❌ "Natural means safe, try it"
:::
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="padding: 20px; background: #f0fff0; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.9em; border-top: 3px solid #2e7d32;"}
::: {.fragment}
✅ Vitamin D has **modest credible evidence** for depressive symptoms, especially in deficient patients
:::

::: {.fragment}
✅ For most other nutrients: too weak to act on
:::

::: {.fragment}
✅ Targeted deficiency assessment may have a role in selected patients
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: notes
I want to be explicit about what we can and can't conclude. The evidence doesn't support writing vitamin D on every depressed patient's problem list. It supports thinking carefully about whether a specific patient might be deficient — and if so, correcting that has the best evidence base we found.
:::

---

## Limitations

::: {.incremental style="font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 2.1;"}
- **High heterogeneity** across all networks (<strong><span class="tau-accent">τ</span></strong> = 0.45 for depression)
  - Prediction intervals are wide even when point estimates look promising

- **Baseline biomarker data** inconsistently reported in ~22% of studies
  - Limits our ability to test deficiency-modification across most nutrients

- **Study-level, not patient-level** subgroup analyses
  - More vulnerable to ecological confounding

- **Sparse evidence** for most nutrients beyond vitamin D
  - Wide credible intervals do not equal proof of no effect

- **Low to very low confidence** for most comparisons (CINeMA)
  - As always, better research needed
:::

::: notes
I don't want to oversell this. The heterogeneity is real. The subgroup data are study-level — a weaker form of evidence. And for most nutrients outside vitamin D, we simply don't have enough good studies to draw firm conclusions in either direction. Tau did reduce accounting for baseline status, and removing Iranian studies.
:::

---

## What to do Monday morning {background-color="#2774AE"}

::: {style="color: white; font-size: 0.92em; line-height: 2.5; margin-top: 20px;"}
::: {.incremental}
- **Patient asks about supplements for depression:**
→ "Evidence is strongest for vitamin D — but only if you're deficient"

- **Consider checking vitamin D** in depressed patients at higher risk for deficiency
→ Older adults, limited sun exposure, darker skin, malabsorption

- **Don't recommend broad supplementation** — evidence isn't there yet

- **Patients already taking supplements:** counsel on dose limits; more isn't always better
:::
:::

::: notes
The practical close. A framework for answering the question your patients are already asking. Vitamin D in the right patient, with the right indication. Everything else: honest uncertainty.
:::
